papers.summary: Grasping and manipulation of deformable materials in robotic cells is often costly and not widely accessible. This paper introduces a method for dexterously lifting textile deformable materials from one edge in manufacturing, using a previously developed gripper designed for deformable materials and an improved version that minimizes material vibrations. papers.summary: A policy trained inside a learned world model is graded by the model it is optimized against. We measure what that does to the grade. papers.title: Quantum Transformer World model
papers.summary: A Quantum Transformer World Model — code and run records Implementation and complete experimental records for work on quantum sequence modelling and model-based reinforcement learning. The architecture. A transformer over a window of recent latent states, with a parameterised quantum circuit (PQC) as the token-mixing block of one encoder layer, serving as the dynamics prior of a DreamerV3-style recurrent state-space model and trained end to end. Because latent imagination rolls the model forward on the prior alone, the policy trains entirely on trajectories generated through a quantum circuit.
